t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes lead to different coloured baskets. Pick the gnomes that lead you to the red basket until you get 1 or  mushrooms. Then, pick the gnomes that lead you to the yellow basket.

vb_textbox.text: During the game you will be given the option between two different coloured GNOMES. Each GNOME leads to a different coloured BASKET. RED, PINK, PURPLE and BROWN will lead you to a RED BASKET. Alternatively, GNOMES that lead to the YELLOW BASKET are YELLOW, ORANGE, BLUE and GREEN. To earn the most amount of points you need to switch between the two BASKETS. First, choose the coloured GNOMES that will only lead you to the RED BASKET. Continue to do this until you only collect 1 or 0 mushrooms. Then only choose GNOMES that will lead you to the YELLOW BASKET. Continue to switch back and forth between the BASKETS every time you only collect 1 or 0 mushrooms throughout the game. Good luck!
